sentences.en: The owner of this bar never sells liquor on credit.
sentences.zh: 这家酒吧的老板从不赊酒。

sentences.en: I bought a bottle of beer at the liquor store.
sentences.zh: 我在便利店买了一瓶啤酒。

sentences.en: I want to be able to hold my liquor better.
sentences.zh: 我想让自己更好地喝酒而不醉。
